column3: NKJV reads “Gadarenes,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads Γερασηνῶν (“Gerasenes”).
Close to the Greek; “I adjure You” is rendered “I implore You.”
NKJV has “near the mountains,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “near the hill.”
NKJV has “all the demons,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has only “they begged Him.”
NKJV includes “at once Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He permitted them.”
NKJV names “Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus. “Your own” is rendered “your friends,” and “had mercy” as “has had compassion.”
Close to the Greek; “flow” is rendered “fountain.”
